name: @ucos/contract-generator
description: UCOS Contract Skeleton Generator (PHASE 12 — WI-07). Deterministic, fail-closed pipeline: Contract Catalog inventory -> canonical generator model -> transport-neutral SDK skeletons (interfaces, operation clients, request/response/error scaffolds, registry manifests). Registry-driven; emits only Stage-3 PARTIAL-permitted skeletons; never invents deferred field-level schemas.
